text: The Board of Health will introduce and enact: Bill No. 1 - To repeal By-law 2-2019 Governing the Proceedings of the Board of Health for the City of Toronto Health Unit. Bill No. 2 - To Govern the Proceedings of the Board of Health for the City of Toronto Health Unit.

The Board of Health introduced and enacted the following: 1. Bill No. 1 - To repeal By-law 2-2019 Governing the Proceedings of the Board of Health for the City of Toronto Health Unit. 2. Bill No. 2 - To Govern the Proceedings of the Board of Health for the City of Toronto Health Unit.
